crossRefs.note: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar…
They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek…
“Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
translations.bsb: As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion extending from the east side to the west side.
